title: Review CloudTrail Logs for Specific IAM Activities
description: Deeply analyze the CloudTrail logs to find detailed records of the IAM activities that match the unauthorized access attempts.
recommended_next_focus: Further investigate the IAM activities to gather more context about the threat.

title: Correlate Identity Activity with CloudTrail Events
description: Examine the IAM activities logged in CloudTrail to see which ones correspond to the unauthorized access attempts.

recommended_next_focus: Identify areas where better logging practices could prevent similar incidents in the future.
